high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring an anime-style character standing on a beach. The character is wearing a long black coat with a fur-lined hood and is facing away from the viewer, looking out towards the ocean. The beach is sandy, and the water appears calm with a gradient of blue hues, transitioning from lighter to darker shades as it meets the horizon. The text overlay at the top of the image reads: "When your name is Crocodile but you can't swim." This text is a play on words, referencing the character's name (Crocodile) and the fact that crocodiles are not known for their swimming abilities.
